rejectionGroups.reason: These graphic tanks are band-, slogan- or bodybuilding-led, frequently long or deeply cut, and cannot support a clean versatile wardrobe.
These T-shirts rely on cheap cartoons, misspelled pseudo-brand text, crosses, cars, cassettes, portraits or giant graphics and read novelty-led rather than modern Zara-led.
The product-only abstract-print short-sleeve shirt is visually busy, synthetic-looking and lacks trustworthy adult fit proof.
These photographed bottoms are excessively wide, ballooned, puddled, camouflage or novelty-colored and fail the controlled-leg requirement.
Despite the wide-leg title, both photographed variants are visibly skinny-tapered office pants and the metadata-to-image mismatch makes the identity unreliable.
The generic drawstring trouser changes from a controlled dark leg to a wider crinkled light-gray shape and does not provide a consistent premium silhouette.
These product-only wide jeans and trousers lack reliable on-body fit proof through the waist, thigh and shoe break; several use dated washes, bulbous shaping or gimmick buttons.
The below-knee cropped wide trouser creates an awkward dated proportion and is not versatile enough for the modern scenario matrix.
